The '''executioner's hack''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] which saw use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. A massive [[Axe/Legends|axe]], it was a favorite weapon among operatives of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], a criminal organization active at the time. Although it was balanced as a two-[[Limb/Legends|handed]] weapon, its low weight gave it the possibility to be used as a one-handed one. Black Sun operatives active within the [[Death Watch bunker]] on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] were known to carry schematics of the weapon.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The executioner's hack appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The executioner's hack was made from a schematic which can be looted from enemies in the Death Watch bunker on Endor. The schematic could then be taken to a [[Arms dealer/Legends|Munitions Trader]] who crafted the weapon. Although its in-game description states it could be used as both a two-handed and one-handed weapon, it was only usable by the player as a two-handed weapon.<ref name="SWG" />
